thread:
hana (compliance): Kicking off the quarterly least-privilege sweep. Please mark role owners in the sheet by Fri COB. Link: https://redwood.internal/access-review/q2 :spiral_calendar:

leo (sec-eng): FYI found a batch of admin bindings created during onboarding that have no owners. Might be from the legacy bootstrap script.

nina (cloud-ops): Can you list the bindings? I can run a quick detection query.

leo (sec-eng): Example: projects/payments -> role:project-admin -> members: []

raj (platform): We should detect ownerless admin roles with a scheduled job and flag for 48hr auto-remediation if no owner claimed. Proposed query:
```
SELECT project, role FROM rbac_bindings WHERE role ILIKE '%admin%' AND cardinality(members)=0;
```

hana (compliance): Auto-remediation OK but need evidence chain. Any auto changes must generate a cert record and a compliance ticket.

leo (sec-eng): Also running into KMS audit gaps for on-prem proxy — several Encrypt/Decrypt events missing from last rotation window. Filed ticket S-824.

nina (cloud-ops): That might be the forwarder crash. I patched the proxy yesterday. I can reingest missed events; please send me the key ids.

leo (sec-eng): Key ids: kms-pay-3, kms-pay-7, kms-int-1. Attached quick log grep I ran:
```
grep "kms" /var/log/kms-proxy/forwarder.log | tail -n 200 | grep -E "kms-pay-3|kms-pay-7|kms-int-1"
```

raj (platform): For the canary to remove broad AdminAccess, propose we pick 8 low-risk service accounts and run a 2-step plan: 1) remove admin binding 2) apply scoped role. Monitor app errors and authz denials for 30m. Rollback if >3 errors or any data loss.

hana (compliance): Sounds reasonable. We need to document the rollback criteria and timeline in the audit packet. Also set audit retention for KMS logs to 180 days for any keys used by payments or billing teams.

nina (cloud-ops): Retention delta estimate: ~9GB/mo incremental. Tagging @finance for approval.

infra-bot: Created ticket RWA-2026-158 (ownerless-role-sweep). Assigned: leo,nina,raj,hana. ETA: 2026-05-03.

leo (sec-eng): One more safety measure: rotate any keys linked to orphaned bindings before reassigning. Adds safety in case creds leaked.

raj (platform): Agreed. I'll add rotation step into the playbook. Also will surface a metric in Console: role_reassign_failures per minute.

hana (compliance): OK team. Owners: hana (evidence & audit), leo (detection + canary), raj (automation + rotation), nina (logs + reingest). Target run: 2026-05-04 08:00 PT. Please ack here.

leo (sec-eng): ack
nina (cloud-ops): ack
raj (platform): ack

hana (compliance): Thanks. If anyone sees an ownerless admin outside the query scope, DM me. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
